_about: Option generators: citywide calendars, venues and teams whose listings feed the 'Coming up' list. Hand-edited. Unlike orgs.json these are not groups we follow — they are where the options come from. Same fields and knobs as an org entry (kind_strict, cap, feed.exclude); `kind` and `reach` are defaults applied when a listing gives no better clue. tools/milwaukee/build.py reads this and writes events.json; it never writes this file. Read by their own calendar feeds as of 2026-09-20: Urban Milwaukee, Marcus Center, Admirals, Brewers, Eventbrite, Pabst Theater Group, Fiserv Forum, Visit Milwaukee. Probed 2026-09-13 and not re-probed: Summerfest, OnMilwaukee's and Milwaukee Record's listings, County Parks are app-rendered or blocked to feed readers — link-only until that changes.

sources.name: Urban Milwaukee calendar
sources.what: The broadest public calendar in town: venues, nonprofits and promoters post here directly.

sources.name: Marcus Performing Arts Center
sources.what: Touring Broadway, the Symphony's neighbor, Peck Pavilion outdoors in summer.

sources.name: Milwaukee Admirals
sources.what: AHL hockey at Panther Arena, October to April. Cheap seats, downtown.
sources.where: UW–Milwaukee Panther Arena, 400 W Kilbourn Ave

sources.name: Milwaukee Brewers
sources.what: Home games at American Family Field. Tailgating is the point.

sources.name: Eventbrite (Milwaukee)
sources.what: Everything self-listed: shows, classes, pop-ups, fundraisers, trivia nights. Read from the listing pages' embedded data, so times, venues and categories come through.

feed.exclude: shuttle|bus to|parking|webinar|boat (sale|show)|pre-owned|dealership|vehicle sale|liquidation|job fair|career fair|certification|cpr class|notary|troubleshooting|install|hvac|beers with peers|networking|mixer|open enrollment|info session|realtor|licensing|continuing education

sources.name: Pabst Theater Group
sources.what: The Pabst, the Riverside, Turner Hall Ballroom, Miller High Life Theatre, the Vivarium, the Fitzgerald. Read from their month view, so shows are listed months ahead with start times.

sources.name: Visit Milwaukee events
sources.what: The tourism bureau's calendar of everything from concerts and plays to festivals and one-off classes. The full listing is mostly standing attractions, daily tours and weekly happy hours, so the feed keeps single-day listings, short runs, and recurring ones only in performance/festival/market/sports categories.

feed.recurring_keep: ^(live music|comedy & improv|performing arts & theater|festival|fairs & markets|film & literature|spectator sports)$
